data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'h-b-y', meaning to be joyful, glad, or radiant. In Islamic tradition, Haibaa symbolizes the joy and contentment that comes from leading a righteous and spiritual life. The name Haibaa carries the meaning “Joyful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haibaa usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
